stratification: domain-primary (round-robin over hand-mapped bins, seeded shuffle within bin); acceptance year recorded and reported, not stratified on
eligibility_filter: >=2 of six metadata surfaces present, applied after phase0 probe, acceptance in rank order
dedup_rules: R3 JOSS version papers -> most recent kept
R5 non-GitHub host -> exclude (all six eligibility surfaces are probed through the GitHub API)
known_confound: every JOSS project carries a paper DOI by construction; dual-listed pyOpenSci rows inherit this; comparison presented as illustrative, not inferential
domain_binning: keyword map (domain_map.csv, committed; first match wins, disciplinary keywords precede generic ones). Candidates matching no keyword form an 'unmapped' bin that participates in the stratified draw
